title: Orbit Engineers
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build'

checks.interaction: Next, Back, Back to top, home, Begin Your Mission, desktop navigation, keyboard Enter, wheel does not navigate; Reach Out mailto href verified
checks.media: All three supplied videos loaded and playing; active video opacity 1; Inter loaded
checks.layout: No document overflow or out-of-viewport text/control bounds in the six scene/viewport combinations

notes: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and lucide-react implemented as specified.
Original supplied videos and Google Fonts Inter are local assets; decorative SVG images are original because no source URLs were supplied.
Reach Out targets a fictional placeholder email inbox; only its href was validated.
Desktop navigation reuses the specified three scenes; no extra pages were added.
Motion transitive dependency versions pinned for compatibility; successful build has benign upstream use-client directive warnings.
Chromium checks use the available Docker image; no claim of physical-device testing.
